newsitem.title: FINLAND: KYRO SETS FIM 22-27/SHR ISSUE PRICE, SEEKS LISTING.
newsitem.headline: KYRO SETS FIM 22-27/SHR ISSUE PRICE, SEEKS LISTING.

text.p: Finnish machinery and power company Kyro Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its board had decided that the subscription price in its issue of up to 8.18 million new shares would be at least 22 markka and at most 27 markka per share.
"The share's minimum subscription price is 22 markka and the maximum subscription price is 27 markka," Kyro said.
Subscriptions would be recieved from May 19, it said, addikng the issue prospectus would be published on May 13.
"The company has today submitted an application to the Helsinki stock exchange for a listing of its shares," Kyro said.

The group's earnings trend had been weaker than expected early this year, Kyro said, adding this was due to losses at its Tecnomen unit, while Tamglass and Kyro Power had beaten budgeted targets. It said it expected the group's operating result for the first four months to be "just slightly positive".
Due to Tecnomen, it was possible that the group's full-year operating profit would "remain somewhat behind" the 1996 operating profit of 103.6 million markka, Kyro said.
"Due to extraordinary items, the group's net profit is, however, expected to exceed the 1996 net profit," it said, referring to its 54.6 million markka profit for the fiscal year.
"The outlook for the group for 1998 is good," Kyro said.
